nom: RODAN + FIELDS Redefine Daily Foaming Face Cleanser

avis.texte: I really love this product. It cleans the makeup off and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight.
Love the cleanser and use daily for past 10+ years. My skin's tone and clarity definitely is healthy and more even. I believe it is helping with keeping more vibrant during the aging process.
Nothing compares. The best m. Works so well. Been obsessed for a long time and my husband uses it too
This cleanser is my favorite. It is so easy to apply and spreads nicely on my face and neck. I like the feel of my skin after I have cleansed my face.
I love this foaming cleanser. It's so gentle but cleans my face and makes my skin so soft. I will not use anything else!! It's the absolute best!
I have used this cleanser for years at night. It thoroughly cleans my face after a long day.
I like the texture and how a small amount covers and cleans my face.
This has been a fantastic cleanser to use. It's gentle on my skin but cleans my mascara and makeup off well. I'll definitely be buying it again!
Been using this for over 10 years and will continue to do so. Love it!
The products being my skin up a level and help fight weather and other elements daily.

This cleanser is a great selection and perfect addition to my skin care routine. It is light and has a nice clean fragrance. It only takes a very small amount to do the work and removes all the makeup without leaving skin feeling dry.
My face always feels smooth and clean after using the Daily Foam Cleanser. It is my first choice for cleansing.
I've been using this cleaner for 3 years. I have very good skin with no issues. This cleanser is awesome & I do feel helps me continue with great skin
This is my favorite cleanser!! It makes my skin feel so wonderful!!
Another favorite, I love the new and improved version of this. I was always using the clay mask before she was always so dry from it. This makes your skin so soft and clean.
Gentle, moisturizing product without concerning exfoliants for this aged skin
Love this cleanser, leaves my face feeling moisturized and soft.
My go-to in the morning! It feels great and my skin feels so refreshed!
I have been using Redefine Foaming Cleanser for a couple years now. Love the creamy texture and how clean my face feels after using it.
I have tried other products to test them out and always come back to my R&F products! Doesn't dry my skin out and leaves my face feeling clean.

avis.titre: Loved this face cleanser for decades!
avis.texte: Actually, any product from R&F has ALWAYS given me beautiful results!! This facial cleanser has been my all-time fav for literally decades! Thanks R&F for providing stellar skin products!
I love the way this cleanser feels on my face, very luxurious!

Perfect cleanser for removing make up. Gentle enough for daily use - I bring this cleanser with me on every trip it is suitable for any occasion. This cleanser coupled with the toner is one of the best combinations on the market.
I love this cleanser and know I can trust products with the R&F label on it! My skin is already dry so I value a product that cleanses without stripping the moisture from my skin!
I've been using redefine daily foaming cleanser for seven years now. It always makes my skin feel clean and moisturized. It leaves a clean slate so I can apply my sunscreen and my makeup.
Little pea size amount of this product & some water goes a long way to clean your face. Skin feels super soft after as well.
Love this product. It keeps my skin feeling clean, fresh and smooth.

I like the foaming face cleanser, but I am more likely to purchase the other cleanser from Rodan and Fields the next time. There's something about the micro dermabrasion of the other redefined cleanser that I like better.
Gentle foam wash with good results. I prefer the exfoliating facial wash.
Refefine Daily Foaming Cleanser is my all time favorite cleanser. It is a light, gentle cleanser. The cleanser foams up nicely, leaving my face feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated.
It's a very gentle cleanser much different then the exfoliating cleanser but still affective.
I love the foaming action,and the results of a clean and refreshing face.
It is advised to always have 2 of these. One for shower and one for your sink.
I like this cleanser. It doesn't make my skin feel dry. It doesn't remove makeup by itself, but it's a good cleanser for makeup free skin.
Soft foam and effective cleansing. Leaves my skin soft and clean.
I ordered the wrong one. I prefer the Redefine cleanser with the grit.
This is my first time trying a product from this brand and I am enjoying it very much.
Does the job, only use it 4 days a week. I only use the cleansers.
I think it is a good product. It cleans thoroughly and leaves no residue.
The foaming cleanser cleans make up at the end of the day thoroughly, but gentle enough to not dry my skin out. It is wonderful!
My favorite of the RF cleansing products! Never left feeling dry, always removes my makeup
This was my first time trying the foaming cleanser I have always used Clay. Now I use the foaming cleanser the days I wear makeup and the clay when I don't.
This is a constant in my routine. It's gentle enough to use twice a day.
Switched for the winter from the clay cleanser to daily foaming cleanser as my skin gets dryer
Redefine daily foaming cleanser I used this for many years and I absolutely love it clean not a lot of chemicals takes my make up and everything off so easily, love it
I've been using this cleanser for years. I love how fresh it leaves my skin. It rinses clean.
The daily foaming cleanser really makes my skin feel soft and clean. Love the R+D REDEFINE line. I use all of the products in that line on a daily basis.
I love using the redefine daily foaming cleanser. I use it because it is gentle on my face and it has my face to appear clean and feels very clean and hydrated.

The REDEFINE Daily Foaming Cleanser is my favorite. It gently cleans my skin and removes my makeup. It does not dry my skin and leaves it feeling soft and refreshed. I use it in the morning and evening.
I love the way it feels. I leave it on as a mask and also use it as a scrub. My skin feels great!
I like the ease of this effectively removing my makeup and cleaning my pores!
Love this. Just need a pea size amount to clean your face. Leaves my face clean and moisturized.
Love the feel of it and how it makes masking feel. Soft and firm.
It is a super great foaming cleanser takes very little to sets up and cleans the face
It cleans really well and a pea sized amount is all you need to clean your face making it very economical.
I love this product. The frothy texture it creates cleanses my skin perfectly. Nothing like it!
Like the ease of the wash vs the mask, good lather, only need a very small amount.

avis.texte: This product is recommended as needed only sparingly, however, I don't feel my facial wash is completely cleansing unless I use a quarter size(vs a dime). I hesitate to use a quarter's worth however, for fear of running out of my product that cost this much too soon.
I alternate tha foaming cleanser with the clay cleanser. It never irritates my skin!
Love the foaming aspects of this product - my face feels clean and takes care of all the make-up
THis is easy to use and its okay. I have had better cleansers.
My go to daily face wash. Gentle yet thorough in removing make up and the daily grime.
I have been using this product off and on for quite a while and really like it. It makes my skin feel so clean and soft.
This is one of my favorites. It does the job well without drying my skin.
I love the way this lathers. It takes very Little to do the job. Great product. I love it compared to the original cleanser.
This is my favorite cleanser & I do rotate with the clay cleanser daily!! I use the Redefine products!!
I have been using this face wash for years and I never want to switch! I love the way it foams up and cleanses my face. My skin feels refreshed and smooth! This is the only cleanser I will ever use!
I like the foaming feel, but I like the other redefine cleanser better since it exfoliates well. This one is good if you don't like the exfoliation of the other one.
It is usually creamy and foamy and now it seems like it has changed. . . it is gritty and I get it in my eyes and I don't like that feel.
I have been using the Redefine foaming cleanser since it came out and love it!

I like this cleanser as it seems gentle on my skin, but it smells strongly like good old-fashion bar soap. I know it IS a form of soap, but the smell is just a bit off putting. I have used this product for years, I don't know if the formula has changed or why it's affecting me now, but that is the only thing I don't like about it. It works well.
It is my go to cleanser every evening before bed. I use it with the clay cleanser once or twice per week. Prefer the quick clean with the foaming one.
I like this cleanser, but I wish it lathered more. It cleans well.
I use this every morning on my face in the shower and follow with the moisturizer.
